description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Microsoft is hiring a Software Engineer to build and support client and service components for Intune, its enterprise device and app management platform. The role involves developing production software across multiple technology stacks, safely supporting releases used by millions, and collaborating to resolve customer problems and improve engineering quality.
Software Engineer designing, implementing, and supporting production software with AI tools under oversight, safely releasing at scale

Responsibilities:
• Leverages modern AI tools to design, implement, and support production software for various tech stacks with appropriate oversight and discipline
• Releases and supports what you build safely to millions of users
• Collaborates with other engineers and disciplines to solve urgent customer problems
• Strengthens team-wide engineering quality, efficiency, and culture beyond individual task ownership
• Learns to become a better software engineer every day

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

+ OR equivalent experience
• Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python
• OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python
• OR equivalent experience
